question: What ritual arrangement should the wise practitioner employ when worshipping Viṣṇu?
premises: The wise practitioner is the prescribed agent of worship.
Viṣṇu is the designated object of worship.
The worship includes an outer surrounding of world-guardians.
inference: Therefore the wise practitioner should worship Viṣṇu with the world-guardians arranged outside.
plain_english: The wise one should worship Viṣṇu, surrounded on the outside by the guardians of the directions.
